command:
import pathlib,tempfile,socket,subprocess,json
w=pathlib.Path.cwd()
with socket.socket() as s:
 s.bind(('127.0.0.1',0));port=s.getsockname()[1]
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='pixel-owned-browser-') as d:
 p=pathlib.Path(d)/'playwright.config.ts';url=f'http://127.0.0.1:{port}'
 p.write_text('import original from '+json.dumps(str(w/'playwright.config.ts'))+';\nexport default {...original,testDir:'+json.dumps(str(w/'e2e'))+',outputDir:'+json.dumps(str(pathlib.Path(d)/'results'))+',use:{...original.use,baseURL:'+json.dumps(url)+'},webServer:{...original.webServer,command:'+json.dumps(f'pnpm dev --port {port} --strictPort')+',cwd:'+json.dumps(str(w))+',url:'+json.dumps(url)+',reuseExistingServer:false}};\n')
 raise SystemExit(subprocess.run(['pnpm','exec','playwright','test','--config',str(p)]).returncode)
